newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kolbenschmidt - Q1 profit rise unsustainable.
newsitem.headline: Kolbenschmidt - Q1 profit rise unsustainable.

text.p: German car components group Kolbenschmidt AG said on Thursday it did not expect that the profit growth experienced in the first quarter of its 1996/1997 financial year would continue through whole year.
"I am not working on the basis that the profit for the whole year will rise by more than 30 percent," Kolbenschmidt chief Heinrich Binder told a news conference.
He said that a moderate rise both in profit and turnover was likely. Earlier, the group reported a rise in pre-tax profits of around a third to 12.6 million marks in the first quarter of the year.
Binder said the rise was a delayed reaction to improvements in its cost structure put in place earlier.
